name: 实现 EnvironmentService
description:
实现 EnvironmentService 服务方法: listEnvironments, createEnvironment, updateEnvironment
  - listEnvironments: listEnvironments(projectId: string, current?: integer, pageSize?: integer): Promise<{ data: Environment[], total: integer, current: integer, pageSize: integer }> pre=projectId 必须存在且属于当前用户
  - createEnvironment: createEnvironment(projectId: string, body: { name: string, host: string, port: integer, username: string, authType: string, password?: string, identityFile?: string }): Promise<{ id: string }> pre=projectId 必须存在；body 中 name, host, port, username, authType 不
  - updateEnvironment: updateEnvironment(projectId: string, envId: string, body: { name?: string, host?: string, port?: integer, username?: string, authType?: string, password?: string, identityFile?: string }): Promise<void> pre=projectId 和 envId 必须存在且属于当前用户

acceptance_criteria.description: listEnvironments 方法实现满足前置条件: projectId 必须存在且属于当前用户
acceptance_criteria.expected: 返回值符合 listEnvironments(projectId: string, current?: integer, pageSize?: integer): Promise<{ data: Environment[], total: integer, current: integer, pageSize: integer }>

acceptance_criteria.description: createEnvironment 方法实现满足前置条件: projectId 必须存在；body 中 name, host, port, username, authType 不能为空
acceptance_criteria.expected: 返回值符合 createEnvironment(projectId: string, body: { name: string, host: string, port: integer, username: string, authType: string, password?: string, identityFile?: string }): Promise<{ id: string }>

acceptance_criteria.description: updateEnvironment 方法实现满足前置条件: projectId 和 envId 必须存在且属于当前用户
acceptance_criteria.expected: 返回值符合 updateEnvironment(projectId: string, envId: string, body: { name?: string, host?: string, port?: integer, username?: string, authType?: string, password?: string, identityFile?: string }): Promise<void>

context.module_overview: 环境管理服务，提供环境列表展示、新增、编辑、删除、测试连接、设置默认环境等功能。

methods.name: listEnvironments
methods.signature: listEnvironments(projectId: string, current?: integer, pageSize?: integer): Promise<{ data: Environment[], total: integer, current: integer, pageSize: integer }>
methods.precondition: projectId 必须存在且属于当前用户
methods.postcondition: 返回该项目的环境列表及分页信息，data 包含 Environment 对象数组

methods.name: createEnvironment
methods.signature: createEnvironment(projectId: string, body: { name: string, host: string, port: integer, username: string, authType: string, password?: string, identityFile?: string }): Promise<{ id: string }>
methods.precondition: projectId 必须存在；body 中 name, host, port, username, authType 不能为空
methods.postcondition: 创建成功返回新环境的 ID；若连接信息无效，应返回错误

methods.name: updateEnvironment
methods.signature: updateEnvironment(projectId: string, envId: string, body: { name?: string, host?: string, port?: integer, username?: string, authType?: string, password?: string, identityFile?: string }): Promise<void>
methods.precondition: projectId 和 envId 必须存在且属于当前用户
methods.postcondition: 环境信息更新成功；若设置为默认环境，原默认环境被取消
